parameters.content:
## sub-run-skill
Generic, reusable "call a skill" sub-workflow -- the direct replacement for skill-runner.mjs's invokeOnce. Called via Execute Workflow with {systemPrompt, userInput, schemaName, webSearch?}. Five of the seven skills (research-contact, attribute-voice-memo, classify-contact-intent, extract-note-contacts, and process-cards's field-extraction half) share this contract -- match-contact and process-cards's crop step get their own carved-out sub-workflows per the plan (multi-turn Zoho tool use, interleaved vision + deterministic file ops).

webSearch (added Stage 2, for research-contact) maps to the Anthropic node's own options.webSearch -- the native server-side web_search tool the plan confirmed this node supports directly, no HTTP Request workaround. Defaults to false for every existing caller (an unmapped Execute Workflow input resolves to undefined, and undefined === true is false), so this is backward compatible with sub-classify-contact-intent as-is.

Circuit breaker check/trip lives here, in exactly one place, so every future caller gets it for free -- the n8n-side replacement for skill-runner.mjs's single in-process claudeBlockedUntil variable, which can't work across n8n's separate-process executions.

Retry uses the Anthropic node's own Retry On Fail setting (3 tries, 3s apart) instead of a hand-rolled loop -- replaces invokeOnce's retry, not the circuit breaker (a 429 also trips the breaker via the error branch, checked by regex against the error message since the plain Anthropic node has no structured error-code field to branch on directly).

VERIFY BEFORE THIS LEAVES DRAFT: the exact output field name the Anthropic node puts the merged response text under (content vs text vs output) hasn't been confirmed against a live execution -- Validate & Return defensively checks all three shapes, but this needs a real test run to pin down and simplify. Same for whether options.includeMergedResponse actually produces the field name assumed here, and (new with webSearch) whether a web-search-augmented response still lands in the same field or wraps citations differently.

Schema validation inlines the full n8n/schemas/schemas.mjs (zod, via NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL) rather than reimplementing as canvas branching -- see the plan, "Output validation": a Code node keeps MatchOutput's five .refine() invariants as one diffable, testable unit instead of risking drift between what the rule says and what the canvas checks.

Failure (blocked / API error / validation failure) always returns {success: false, error} rather than throwing -- callers (e.g. pipeline-contact-intent) branch on success and do nothing on failure, leaving the row pending for the next claim, same as skill-runner.mjs throwing does today.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 1/2). "Postgres (n8n pipeline)" and "Anthropic API" are placeholder names -- no credential is actually attached (n8n instance has zero credentials configured) -- see n8n/README.md.
